title: dns.resolve raises OSError when refreshing the overview
body:
Environment

Lattice 3.2.1, Fedora 41 Workstation, server ap-south-1.

Steps

To reproduce:
- Start by refreshing the overview.
- Keep the application open overnight, then trigger the action.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

Expected

No traceback; refreshing the overview normally takes a few seconds.

Actual

It fails only after the app has run for many hours. The number of open files in the monitor climbs over a long session and never drops.

Frequency

Happens on about half the runs.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/ui/view.py:213 in refresh
lattice/report/live.py:59 in tiles
lattice/net/dns.py:176 in resolve
OSError: [Errno 8] nodename nor servname provided (host=ap-south-1)
